# Extra D1 residual-spectrum jobs: adding n=512 instability follow-up (seed2 training
# instability observed) -- additional seeds 3-7 to quantify frequency, plus a doubled-steps
# rerun of seed 2 (via --tag long) to check whether the instability is a step-budget effect.
# Same parameters as the existing jobs/d1_spectrum.txt adding_n512_s{0,1,2} lines
# (generated by make_r2_d1_jobs.py); not launched, not merged into d1_spectrum.txt.
run_e1_spectrum.py --task adding --n 512 --seed 3 --steps 20000 --batch 4 --lr 1e-3 --ckpt_fracs 0.01,0.05,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0 --ckpt_align age --outdir results/r2/d1_spectrum --tag extra  # out=results/r2/d1_spectrum/adding_n512_s3_extra.json
run_e1_spectrum.py --task adding --n 512 --seed 4 --steps 20000 --batch 4 --lr 1e-3 --ckpt_fracs 0.01,0.05,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0 --ckpt_align age --outdir results/r2/d1_spectrum --tag extra  # out=results/r2/d1_spectrum/adding_n512_s4_extra.json
run_e1_spectrum.py --task adding --n 512 --seed 5 --steps 20000 --batch 4 --lr 1e-3 --ckpt_fracs 0.01,0.05,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0 --ckpt_align age --outdir results/r2/d1_spectrum --tag extra  # out=results/r2/d1_spectrum/adding_n512_s5_extra.json
run_e1_spectrum.py --task adding --n 512 --seed 6 --steps 20000 --batch 4 --lr 1e-3 --ckpt_fracs 0.01,0.05,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0 --ckpt_align age --outdir results/r2/d1_spectrum --tag extra  # out=results/r2/d1_spectrum/adding_n512_s6_extra.json
run_e1_spectrum.py --task adding --n 512 --seed 7 --steps 20000 --batch 4 --lr 1e-3 --ckpt_fracs 0.01,0.05,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0 --ckpt_align age --outdir results/r2/d1_spectrum --tag extra  # out=results/r2/d1_spectrum/adding_n512_s7_extra.json
run_e1_spectrum.py --task adding --n 512 --seed 2 --steps 40000 --batch 4 --lr 1e-3 --ckpt_fracs 0.01,0.05,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0 --ckpt_align age --outdir results/r2/d1_spectrum --tag long  # out=results/r2/d1_spectrum/adding_n512_s2_long.json
